purpose: Common image rules for official IRGEZTNE Web Studio templates.

avoid: images where one person becomes the brand of the template
peopleRule.reason: Official templates must stay universal. Demo images may show work and atmosphere, but should not make a specific person the face of the template.

blog-news.people: Allowed only as context, not as portrait.

portfolio.people: Only if the portfolio owner chooses their own images.

agency-studio.people: Context only, no portrait-first demo identity.

demoImageRule.meaning: Images included in official templates are demonstration placeholders used to show layout, mood and visual direction.

userMessage.en: Demo images are placeholders. Replace them with your own images before publishing.
userMessage.ru: Демо-изображения — это заглушки для просмотра шаблона. Перед публикацией замените их своими изображениями.

demoImageRule.reason: Official template images should help users understand the design, but should not become final published content by default.
